content.text:
The exam is written and verified.

**`client/test/sync-origin.test.ts`** — 11 tests, one or more per leg:

- **(a) [M1]** `readSyncOrigin()` over `ws://127.0.0.1:4321`, `wss://x`, and the five `undefined` cases (unset, `http://…`, `42`, `''`, and `globalThis.window` swapped to `undefined` in a `try`/`finally` that restores the descriptor, with the restoration itself asserted).
- **(b) [M2]** `syncUrl('todos')` both ways plus `SERVER` unchanged; then the unseeded/unflagged render with the handle set, asserting the recorded socket URLs equal exactly `['ws://127.0.0.1:4321/sync/todos']`.
- **(c) [M3]** that render exposes `window.__TINYAPP_STORE__`, identical (`toBe`) to the Provider's store, its `getContent()` following the app store through a real `setTodoCompleted`, with one persister and one synchronizer.
- **(d) [M4]** three renders: no handle (one socket, `ws://localhost:9876/sync/todos`, no store handle), a seed (zero sockets), the exam flag (zero sockets).
- **(e) [M5]** `AGENTS.md`'s `## Key Files` section, sliced to `## Working Method` and space-joined, matched with the Proof's first `Run:` regex. The other two `Run:` lines are the last two tests, as M1's and M2's remaining clauses.

At BASE: 4 pass, 7 fail, every failure the absent implementation. A throwaway implementation turned it 11/11 green (and `client/test` 36/36) and was reverted — only the exam file is added. One cross-file hazard found and fixed in the exam: handles left on `window` leak into the next test file (happy-dom reuses the window across unregister/register), so all six are cleared in `afterEach` and `afterAll`.
